propositions: Schema fields in _config_schema.py can ship with zero read sites outside schema/config plumbing, making the knob silently inert.
An AST-level deterministic check must require each _config_schema.py field to have at least one attribute-read site in Load context matching the terminal field name.

The detection must match any real read shape (load_config().section.field, local binding, self.config.section.field, or alias) by terminal attribute name only, deliberately fail-quiet on name collisions, and fire only on zero references.
Fields with indirect reads (getattr dispatch, client-only knobs) must carry a '# read-via: <pointer>' marker with an explicit reason; bare markers without pointers are rejected.
The check must integrate into CI and fail the build when any schema field has zero read sites and no valid read-via marker, with a message teaching remediation.
